query: I maintain a .NET MAUI field-service app and our IT team just rolled out Xcode 27.0. Please inspect the iOS and Mac Catalyst project heads, identify compatibility risks, and prepare a migration plan without touching files.

After switching our MAUI build to Apple's 27 SDK, opening it on a normal iPad flashes the splash image and quits. The device log explicitly requires UIScene lifecycle. Find the missing project changes.
Our MAUI app uses custom scene callbacks and central NuGet versions. Verify our Xcode 27 compatibility work kept home-screen actions and WebAuthenticator return handling intact.
Review the supported toolchain for our .NET MAUI app. The Apple pack is 27.0.10722 but CI selects Xcode 27.1; check the mismatch rather than disabling any checks.
For the existing MAUI shopping screen, rearrange tiles into two panes when the Duo hinge is visible. This is visual-layout work only; startup and Xcode compatibility have already been approved.
Our only MAUI target is net10.0-windows. Review how the splash image is packaged. Please don't introduce any Apple-specific files.
The Swift UIKit sample in this repository crashes on iOS 27 because it hasn't adopted scenes. Implement its native lifecycle; there is no .NET MAUI app here.
I want an inventory of installed Xcode versions and simulator runtimes before a meeting. Do not open or migrate any application project.
